data.turoyo: <...> noše ġer mine məstalamle i mamlaxto. <...>
data.translation: <...> jemand anders hat das Königreich übernommen. <...>

rationale: Thin Preterit/1 cell; kingdom takeover adds an overt acquired domain to the already represented succession to a father's post.

summary: A kingdom, a father's position and military command are parallel objects of übernehmen; no new lexical sense is needed for the difference in institutional domain.
The command noun qiyade remains an ordinary object in the existing sense, not a newly proposed light-verb idiom.
Keep the source's I filing of the Arabic VIII-derived verb. The transitive Preterit uses l-series actor endings; lexical participants are unmarked in 57/20.
